atr_normalization.definition: For each session day, session_range = session_high - session_low using the family session window. ATR14 = Wilder average of those daily ranges, using only prior days (no same-day leak). Scale constants are the median ATR14 on TRAIN dates for that instrument.
atr_normalization.scale: distance_target = distance_NQ * (median_ATR14_target_TRAIN / median_ATR14_NQ_TRAIN), rounded to tick.
